chunks: Abu Jaʿfar عليه السلام was asked about the saying of Allah, Mighty and Majestic,
"And do not give the foolish your wealth."
He عليه السلام said: "Do not give it to a drinker of wine, nor to women."
Then he عليه السلام said: "And what foolish person is more foolish than a drinker of wine?"

key_terms.أَمْوَالَكُمْ: your wealth or property under your responsibility
key_terms.السُّفَهَاءَ: the foolish or weak-minded people who should not be entrusted with wealth
key_terms.النِّسَاءَ: women, mentioned here in the wording of the report regarding entrusting wealth
key_terms.سَفِيهٍ: a foolish person lacking sound judgment
key_terms.شَارِبَ الْخَمْرِ: a drinker of wine; one whose judgment is impaired

ai.seo_question: Who is meant by "the foolish" in Qur'an 4:5 according to Imam al-Baqir عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This report explains the verse as prohibiting the entrusting of wealth to those lacking sound judgment, especially one who drinks alcohol. It presents foolishness here as a practical incapacity in managing property and applies the verse to financial guardianship and control of wealth.
